summary: This best current practice describes a simple process in which authors of Internet-Drafts add an Implementation Status section recording known implementations. That lets reviewers and working groups give proper weight to documents backed by running code, which can be evidence that a specification works.

eli5.summary: Before a recipe goes in a cookbook, it helps to know who has cooked it and how it turned out. This asks authors to list the people who have actually built what they describe.
